first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child seated on Vehicle A with their back to the camera, with neck-length brown hair and a red long-sleeved top; dark blue shoulder straps are visible across the shoulders and back.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low tricycle ridden by Person A, with a blue high backrest, a low red frame, and two wide black rear wheels visible; the front wheel is occluded.

entities.name: carpet
entities.identification: The carpet covering the entire corridor, with a repeating geometric pattern composed of thick orange zigzag lines, dark brown areas, and red inner blocks.

entities.name: right-side doorway
entities.identification: An open doorway in the right interior wall of the corridor with a bright green interior wall; an exit sign and a dark green inner door panel are visible in the early part.

entities.name: corridor wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls on both sides of the corridor, with vertical wall corners and dark brown baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: Dark brown rectangular doors arranged along the corridor; near the left side, there is also a dark decorative doorway area accompanied by a red vertical facade.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling above the corridor, with perimeter molding and transverse segmentation.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: A group of light fixtures arranged lengthwise along the corridor ceiling, with white circular shades and bright lower surfaces.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: A rectangular framed decoration on the corridor wall, with a darker frame and a lighter inner area discernible; the image content is blurred.
